edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner.
msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key in transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the first key of the allowed mapping in approve and approveAndCall.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before writing owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates the token rescue function transferAnyERC20Token.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
Constructor mints _totalSupply to the initial holder address.
transfer reads and writes balances entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances entries for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] through safeSub.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing an external call.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and requires msg.sender to match it.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
transfer delegates the sender balance debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates the balance and allowance decrements to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient balance credit to safeAdd.
safeAdd performs c = a + b followed by the overflow require.
safeSub performs require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
safeMul performs c = a * b with the division-based overflow check.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval.
Control returns from the external callee into approveAndCall, allowing re-entrant state reuse.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an owner-supplied token contract.
The fallback function unconditionally executes revert().
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor credits the initial holder entry in balances.
The tokens parameter controls the amount debited and credited by transfer.
The tokens parameter controls the amount moved by transferFrom.
The tokens argument is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
The spender parameter selects the untrusted contract that is called externally.
Arbitrary caller-supplied data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The owner-controlled parameter becomes the pending new owner.
The to parameter is the credited recipient in transfer.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is the second key written in the allowed mapping.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
approve writes the caller-selected allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the external call.
